# Issue Tracking & Spec Form Requirements Quality Checklist: Issue-Backed Specs

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of requirements for issue creation, failure handling, PR traceability, and the one-page spec form
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the issue content requirements (title, body composition, labels, assignees) specified in the spec rather than only in the contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the target repository for the tracking issue defined unambiguously, including how it is determined from catalog inputs? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for how the issue link is exposed in workflow outputs beyond "visible"? [Completeness, Spec §US1-AS2, FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements stated for where the issue identifier is recorded alongside spec artifacts so downstream workflows can find it? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for how plan and work workflows discover the issue reference? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Is a requirement defined for what happens to the created issue when later steps fail (e.g., issue exists but spec generation fails)? [Gap, Exception Flow]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "visible issue reference" in a PR defined with a specific location (title, body) and format? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "actionable failure" defined with the minimum information the message must contain? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "authenticated workflow requester" distinguished from the workflow's service identity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "discard generated spec artifacts" scoped (local files, branches, drafts, partial PRs)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK011 Are "closing keywords" and the prohibited auto-close mechanisms enumerated in the spec? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the "When practical" assumption reconciled with the unconditional wording of FR-006? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do the Assumptions ("workflow identity" permissions) align with FR-011 (requester identity creates the issue)? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, FR-011]
- [ ] CHK014 Are US2-AS2 / FR-007 (PR proceeds without issue) consistent with SC-002 (100% of PRs with a known issue)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the branch placeholder format in the spec header consistent with the actual feature branch name? [Consistency, Spec §Header]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the form field requirements identical between FR-004, the Clarifications, and contracts/spec-form.md? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]

## Spec Form Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Are validation rules defined for required fields (empty, whitespace-only, maximum length)? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the required story sentence format "As a ____, I can ____" enforced or only prompted? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it specified whether the acceptance criteria pre-populated value `- [ ] ...` left unchanged counts as satisfying "required"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "10-line" / "5-line" defined as visible rows, a maximum length, or both? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the default selection for the spec type radio box defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for how omitted optional fields appear in the issue body? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the term "one page" defined relative to the existing catalog-picker page? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK024 Are help text or description requirements defined for each field to support the "good spec" goal? [Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK025 Can SC-004 ("95% complete a valid first-pass submission") be objectively measured, including the sample, definition of "valid", and measurement method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK026 Is SC-001 "exactly one issue" reconcilable with retries or duplicate submissions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK027 Can SC-003 be verified given how a "human actor" is distinguished from bots and automation tokens? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK028 Does each functional requirement map to at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion? [Traceability, Spec §FR-005, FR-008, FR-010]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 Are expected behaviors defined for missing or revoked issue-creation permissions, including the user-facing outcome? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for the repository having issues disabled? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for GitHub API rate limiting or transient failure (retry vs. fail)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for very long titles or bodies and special characters exceeding GitHub limits? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements defined for the labels (`spec`, type) not existing in the target repository? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK034 Is behavior defined when a PR is created after the issue was manually closed or deleted? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK035 Are recovery requirements defined for re-running after a failure that left partial state? [Gap, Recovery]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK036 Are requirements for token handling (not stored in files, PR text, or logs) stated in the spec rather than only the plan? [Gap, Security]
- [ ] CHK037 Are the minimum GitHub token scopes needed to create issues as the requester documented as requirements? [Gap, Dependency]
- [ ] CHK038 Is an audit or traceability requirement defined for who created each issue? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK039 Is the dependency on the issue-creation capability and its availability documented and validated? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the assumption that the tracking repo equals the component repo validated for components in other repositories? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
